caption: A rubber band stretched between two fingers is let slip at one end; the band snaps back and drops.

sa.check: A rubber band is stretched between two fingers.
It is let slip at one end.
The release comes first, then the snap back, then the drop.

pc.expect: The band shrinks back to its unstretched size at release.
pc.fail: It stays stretched; or it snaps in two; or it stretches further.

pc.expect: The band flies toward the finger still holding it at the instant of release.
pc.fail: It flies away from the holding finger; or it moves before release; or it hangs in the air stretched.
It floats; or rises; or hangs.

pc.expect: The band moves only at release.
pc.fail: It moves before release; or sets off again after landing; or jinks.
The band vanishes or a second appears; or it turns into another object; or it merges with a finger.

pc.expect: The band's colour and the background stay the same.
pc.fail: The band changes colour; or the hands change; or the background rearranges.
